prompt:
Our relationship coaching platform has just received intake questionnaire responses from three new users. The completed intake files are sitting in `intake/pending/` inside your workspace. We need you to process all three of them and produce individual coaching reports.

For each user, read their intake file, analyze their situation using our platform's coaching manual (`SKILL.md` in your workspace), and save the resulting report as a plain text file named `{USER_ID}_report.txt` (e.g., `U-2041_report.txt`) inside the `reports/final/` directory.

Note that one user's intake (U-2041) also includes their partner's responses — make sure the report accounts for the relationship dynamic between them. User U-2043 submitted her intake in Chinese.

Do not use anything from the `reports/draft/` directory — those templates are outdated.
